question: A dealer marks 20% above the cost price and allows a 20% discount. What is the profit or loss per cent?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When an article is marked up by x% and then a discount of x% is given, there is always a net loss.

Loss % = (x² ÷ 100)%

⇒ Loss % = (20² ÷ 100)%

⇒ Loss % = (400 ÷ 100)% = 4%

**∴ The correct answer is Loss of 4%.**
